thread:
sam: heads up — seeing a capacity feedback loop in ap-east for models tagged `mosaic-v2`. queue depth climbs, we throttle, traffic shifts, then hot pods flare up and we hit admission-control repeatedly. noticed ~8 min oscillation.
ida: can you paste the scheduler logs around the spike? also which model version exactly? :thinking:
sam: model=mosaic-v2-2026-03-19, nodepool=ap-east-gpu-3, sample log:
```
2026-03-19T09:12:33Z queue_depth=78 model=mosaic-v2-2026-03-19 pod=pod-77fd egress_ms=3200 admitted=false reason=admission_capacity
2026-03-19T09:12:41Z pod=pod-88ab cpu=95% kvcache=misses=230 backpressure=1
2026-03-19T09:16:12Z queue_depth=17 admitted=true
```
ryan: looks like network egress latency + kv-cache miss pattern. when admission flips we push a lot of short retries which creates the feedback. we should stop retries at client side and route new requests to a lower-capacity variant or queue with longer retry jitter.
maya: short term: can we add a per-model soft RPS cap in the route table for mosaic-v2 in ap-east? e.g. set `max_rps=120` and enable `burst=20` so can breathe.
ida: agree. also suggest enabling prefix-KV warm cache param for that model for a few hours so cold start misses drop.
sam: infra-bot alerted at 09:13 with autoscale flapping message — it tried scale+rebuild twice and failed due to ephemeral GPU quota.
infra-bot: [alert] autoscale:scale_failure region=ap-east reason=quota_exhausted gpu_requested=8 gpu_available=2 retry_count=2
ryan: ok action plan:
- set soft RPS cap on mosaic-v2/ap-east to 120 (ryan)
- enable prefix-KV warming for version mosaic-v2-2026-03-19 for 4h (ida)
- stop client retries for 60m via feature-flag (sam)
- follow up with capacity request to cloud to raise ephemeral GPU quota (maya)
sam: I'll flip the client flag and post the toggle command in #eng-runtime after I finish smoke.
ida: I'll patch the model config now — curl example:
```
curl -X POST "https://router.internal/v1/routes/mosaic-v2/ap-east" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"soft_rps":120,"burst":20}'
```
maya: I already opened ticket with cloud: REF-4231, asked for +6 ephemeral GPUs; assigned to @cloud-ops. ETA 6-12h.
ryan: let's meet in 15 if the cap doesn't reduce queue in two cycles. if it persists we may need to evict large-batch jobs in ap-east and failover to eu-west.
sam: noted. tagging this thread with #oncall and #capacity. will update after client toggle. :white_check_mark:
